annotations.title: Detect language: which language a text is

description: Detect language of a text: the language as an ISO 639-1 and 639-3 code with its English name, from 82 languages (franc), offline and fast. Use to route a message to the right translator, model or support team, or to tag content by language. Example: text=Det här är en mening skriven på svenska om väder och resor.. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
